name: fantasy-minimal-magazine
title_zh: 把任意照片转译成留白极简的杂志海报
tagline_zh: 随手一张图，丢进来就变成 FANTASY 风格的 3:4 编辑海报。不是滤镜，是先把画面拆成抽象素材，再重新排版。
tagline_en: Drop any photo in, get a FANTASY 3:4 editorial poster. No filters—it reduces the image to abstract material, then.
desc_en: Create FANTASY-branded 3:4 minimal editorial magazine posters from user-provided images by reading the image, reducing visual information, translating it into abstract editorial material, composing with large whitespace, and generating content-driven typography. Use when the user asks for "fantasy-极简杂志", "极简杂志海报", "编辑出版海报", "图片转译海报", "FANTASY magazine poster", or wants a quiet archival/minimal pub
why_zh: 它先读图、再减信息，把画面翻译成可排版的抽象元素，最后生成与内容咬合的字体。排版不是套模板。
why_en: It reads the image, strips visual noise, translates it into abstract editorial components, then sets type that responds to.
limit_zh: 只吃单张图片输入，输出是 3:4 单页海报；不处理多图拼贴、不生成系列版式、不导出印刷分色文件。超出单张叙事。
limit_en: Single image in, one 3:4 poster out. No multi-photo collages, no series layouts, no print-separation exports. Beyond one-image storytelling, it stops.
